jobs.description:
BI & Financial Controller

Introduction

Are you driven by financial controlling, and are you passionate about digitalizing manual processes? Do you want to build the bridge between manual operations and the data-driven decision-making foundation of the future? Then you are the BI & Financial Controller  we are looking for!

We are seeking a commercially and technically strong BI & Financial Controller whose primary mission is to shape the backbone of our modern corporate steering. You will bridge deep financial expertise with modern data technologies to eliminate heavy manual routines and build an automated, reliable platform for executive leadership.

Your Impact

As our BI & Financial Controller, you will take ownership of our current manual reporting routines with a clear mandate: to automate and digitalize them. While we operate extensively within concepts and guidelines provided by our international headquarters, you will play a crucial local role. Your impact is felt directly as you push the department toward more data-driven solutions, acting as the vital link between the business, data, and executive management to ensure proactive steering.

Meet Your Team

In Controlling & Analytics, we are facing an exciting transformation journey. We are not fully digitalized yet, but we anticipate and are preparing for this imminent change. You will join a dedicated team where we work determinedly to strengthen our own capacity to develop data-driven solutions. We value professional excellence highly, and we are passionate about actively transforming our field from reactive reporting into proactive product design.

About the job

About the Job

We offer a hybrid and developmental role (Headquarters / Hybrid) where you must thrive at the intersection of daily manual operations and forward-looking automation. You will be responsible for elevating our reporting standards and empowering the organization for a new digital reality.

Your primary tasks will be:

• Operational Reporting: Managing and executing the end-to-end production of daily, weekly, and monthly management reporting packages using standard corporate templates and distribution workflows.

• Automation & Data Ownership: Identifying automation potential across current finance processes and developing digital controlling solutions (KPI frameworks and interactive dashboards).

• KPI Architecture & Financial Steering: Translating strategic corporate goals into measurable, consistent end-to-end driver trees and data-driven performance steering models.

• AI & New Technology: Testing and deploying modern AI tools (e.g., Generative AI) for ad-hoc analysis and predictive forecasting, supported by the international framework.

• Organizational Enablement: Empowering controlling colleagues and operational business units to adopt self-service analytics through hands-on training sessions and best-practice concepts.

• Executive Presentations: Translating BI dashboard outputs and KPI trends into clean, executive-ready presentations and ad-hoc analyses for internal leadership.

About you

About You

We are looking for a profile who enjoys having their hands in the engine room. You do not mind handling and taking ownership of the current manual reporting tasks, but your true motivation lies in eliminating them through smart solutions. You are analytically sharp, possess a creative mindset, and have a genuine enthusiasm for technological innovation.

We also expect you to have:

• Solid Professional Foundation: A university degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable qualification, combined with solid professional experience at the intersection of Finance, Data Analytics, and Controlling.

• Financial Expertise: A sound understanding of core corporate steering concepts (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, value-driver trees) and the ability to translate complex financial dynamics into actionable KPI frameworks.

• Technology & BI Stack: Proficiency with modern BI platforms (e.g., Strategy) and coding (e.g., SQL, BigQuery)

• Language Skills: Full professional proficiency in English is required to ensure seamless collaboration across our cross-functional and international teams. German skills are an advantage, though not a requirement

We offer

• A data-driven and challenging position with broad cross-functional exposure across controlling.

• A dynamic, dedicated, and informal work environment within an international retail group.

• Limitless career opportunities and professional challenges.

• Option for a health insurance package.

• Discount schemes across a wide range of providers within travel, shopping, culture, fitness, and more.

**

Headquarters in the heart of Aarhus**

We have a large, innovative headquarters located at Godsbanen in Aarhus. As an employee, you will have access to:

• Free fitness center.

• In-house massage service.

• A healthy canteen offering breakfast, lunch, and convenient take-away dinner options – all with a minimum of 30% organic ingredients.

• The opportunity to join social activities such as rooftop morning yoga, running club, family days, and Friday bars.

The recruitment process

Feel free to simply send your CV along with a few lines about your motivation for the job! We know how much time and energy job hunting takes, so make it easy on yourself and skip the traditional cover letter.

As we review applications on an ongoing basis, we reserve the right to close the job posting early—saving you from spending time applying if we have already initiated the interview process or found the right candidate.

During the recruitment process, you can expect: screening, a phone interview, a job interview, and potentially a case study.

Do you have any questions?

If you have any questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, please contact our recruiter, Johanne Rasmussen, at +45 60 34 02 38 on weekdays between 09:00 and 14:00, or by sending an email to jobilidlhq@lidl.dk.

Apply today! - Det betaler sig!

jobs.occupation: Full Stack Software Engineer, Android Transactions
jobs.description:
About The Job

Flatpay is enabling merchants to simply and effectively accept payments in-store and online. We are one of the fastest-growing companies in Europe. 100,000+ merchants rely on us today, and we are just getting started.

Every day, merchants take card payments on Flatpay terminals, and the Android Transactions team is behind them. We own the software that runs on those terminals and the backend that connects them to the rest of Flatpay.

We are looking for a full stack engineer who is at home on both sides. On Android you will work on the apps that run on our terminals, including the app that lets a POS drive the terminal and the app that takes the payment itself. On the backend you will work on the Terminal API, the service that connects terminals, POS systems and the Flatpay platform.

You will take real ownership, with freedom to drive technical decisions and a direct impact on how payments are made at a company that has gone from startup to unicorn at record speed.

What you’ll do

• 
Build and maintain the Android apps that run on our payment terminals, including the payment and POS-connectivity apps, using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and Hilt

• 
Develop and evolve the Terminal API backend in Java and Spring Boot

• 
Own features end to end across terminal, backend and infrastructure, from discovery through production

• 
Work with real payment hardware: integrate with the terminal vendor SDKs, debug on physical devices and make payment flows robust

Who you are

• 
3+ years of professional software engineering experience

• 
Experience building Android apps in Kotlin, ideally with Jetpack Compose, coroutines and dependency injection (Hilt or Dagger)

• 
Experience building backend services in Java and Spring Boot, including REST APIs, JPA and relational databases

• 
Understanding of what makes mobile and device software reliable: lifecycle, background work, retries and release management

• 
A habit of writing well-tested code and finding root causes in production issues

• 
Strong communication and collaboration skills

• 
Any experience with fintech, payments, POS or embedded and device-level Android would be a plus

We don’t expect experience with every technology listed below. We’re looking for engineers who can learn quickly and help us build great products.

Android (terminal apps)

• 
Kotlin, Coroutines, Jetpack Compose, Hilt, Room, WorkManager

• 
AWS IoT / MQTT, terminal vendor SDKs (PAX)

Backend (Terminal API)

• 
Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, MySQL, Redis

• 
REST APIs, OpenAPI, OpenFeign, webhooks

• 
AWS IoT, SQS, S3, KMS; MQTT-based device messaging

Platform & Delivery

• 
GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Docker, AWS ECS, Terraform

• 
Feature flags (LaunchDarkly), Esper device management, Sentry, New Relic

Why Flatpay?

As part of our team, you’ll join 2,600+ passionate Flatpayers dedicated to shaping the future of payments.

We offer an inclusive and diverse environment where engineers of all backgrounds are trusted with ownership, encouraged to make an impact, and supported in growing their craft.

Our engineering teams work together from our Herlev office in the greater Copenhagen area. We believe that close collaboration, quick feedback loops, and solving problems side-by-side help us build better products, move faster, and create a stronger engineering culture.

We also provide plenty of perks including free slush ice, an on-site gym, a fully equipped gamer room, and much more.

Perks and benefits

This job comes with several perks and benefits

Near public transit

Near public transit

Free office snacks

Free office snacks

Paid holiday

Paid holiday

Free coffee / tea

Free coffee / tea

Work life balance

Work life balance

Flexible working hours

Flexible working hours

See all 18 benefits

Working at

Flatpay

WHAT IS FLATPAY? At Flatpay, we believe that merchants deserve a payment solution that is easy to understand, affordable, and free from hidden fees. That's why we offer a straightforward pricing model with no setup fees for terminals, no subscription fees, and a flat rate for all card types. It's a breath of fresh air compared to the complicated and confusing pricing structures of our competitors.  What sets Flatpay apart is our dedication. We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our client's evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary? WHAT's THE CULTURE LIKE? Flatpay is a fast-moving, performance-driven environment where people are trusted to take ownership from day one. We value initiative, resilience, and a strong work ethic. Our teams are collaborative and supportive, but we also set clear expectations and hold ourselves accountable to results.  As a growing business, things move quickly. That means you’ll have the opportunity to take on real responsibility early, contribute ideas, and see the impact of your work directly. It also means being comfortable with change, solving problems as they arise, and continuously improving how we operate.  We’re best suited to people who are motivated by challenge, enjoy working towards clear goals, and want to develop in a commercial, high-energy environment. WHY CHOOSE FLATPAY? Flatpay offers the opportunity to take real ownership, develop valuable skills, and grow your career in a fast-moving, ambitious company where performance and initiative are recognised.

jobs.occupation: MCO is searching for a Project and Community Manager
jobs.description:
Help us shape the future of media and technology.

The media industry is changing faster than ever. AI, new technologies and changing audience habits are transforming how we create, distribute and consume content.

At Media City Odense (MCO), we’re bringing together the people and organisations who want to shape what comes next.

Now we’re looking for an ambitious, creative and hands-on Project & Community Manager to join our team in Odense and help take MCO to the next level.

A small team. Big ambitions.

Media City Odense is a growing innovation hub and community connecting some of Denmark’s leading media companies, technology businesses, startups, researchers and educational institutions.

Founded by TV 2 Denmark, JFM, TV 2 Fyn and the University of Southern Denmark, we’ve built a strong foundation for collaboration, innovation and knowledge sharing. And we’re just getting started.

Our ambition is to become Denmark’s leading national hub for media technology and innovation. A place where new ideas turn into real projects, where talent meets opportunity, and where the industry comes together to develop the solutions of tomorrow.

From our annual MediaTech Festival to industry events, innovation projects and new partnerships, we’re building a community that creates value all year round.

And that’s where you come in.

As our new Project & Community Manager, you’ll play a central role in turning ideas and ambitions into activities, experiences and tangible results.

You’ll work closely with our CEO, Event Manager and the wider MCO community, taking ownership of projects while helping develop and strengthen our organisation.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Project management: Plan, coordinate and execute projects and initiatives, from the first idea to the final delivery.

• Events & experiences: Help develop and deliver workshops, networking events, industry sessions and our annual MediaTech Festival.

• Community & relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with our members, partners and stakeholders, ensuring they experience real value from being part of MCO.

• Marketing & communications: Create engaging content for our website, newsletters, social media and other communication channels, including basic visual and graphic content.

• Business development: Contribute ideas, identify opportunities and help develop new initiatives that support MCO’s growth and ambitions.

• Making things happen: Keep projects, partners and priorities moving forward, including the practical details that make the difference.

You’ll have plenty of opportunities to put your own ideas into action, take responsibility and make a visible impact on the organisation.

Who are you?

We’re looking for someone who combines structure with creativity, initiative with execution, and professionalism with a healthy dose of curiosity.

You enjoy working with people, you’re comfortable taking ownership, and you don’t need a detailed instruction manual to get started.

Ideally, you:

• Have experience with project management, events, communications, community building or a related field.

• Are highly organised, proactive and comfortable managing several projects at once.

• Have strong communication skills and can create engaging written and visual content.

• Have a good eye for design and are comfortable using digital tools to produce presentations, social media graphics and marketing materials.

• Enjoy building relationships and working with people across different organisations and industries.

• Are curious about technology, AI, innovation and the future of media.

• Communicate confidently in both Danish and English.

• Thrive in a small team where responsibilities are broad, decisions are made quickly and everyone contributes.

Experience from the media or tech industry is an advantage, but not a requirement. We’re just as interested in your mindset, initiative and ability to deliver as we are in your CV.

What do we offer?

At MCO, you’ll join a small, dedicated team with ambitious plans and the freedom to help shape how we achieve them. You’ll get:

• Real influence: An opportunity to shape projects, activities and the future development of MCO.

• An exciting network: Direct access to leading media companies, technology innovators, entrepreneurs and decision-makers.

• Variety and responsibility: A broad role where no two weeks look quite the same.

• Room to grow: Opportunities to develop professionally, take ownership and explore new ideas.

• A collaborative culture: An informal working environment built on trust, initiative, curiosity and a shared ambition to make a difference.

We’re based in central Odense, working at the intersection of media, technology and innovation, with a growing network across Denmark and beyond.

Ready to join us?

We’d love to hear from you.

Send your CV and a short application telling us who you are, what motivates you and why you’d be a great fit for Media City Odense.

Apply by email: thhah@mediacityodense.dk

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, and expect to complete the recruitment process during November 2026.

The position is full-time, based in Odense, with a start date to be agreed upon.

Come help us build what’s next.

We are an experience innovation and digital transformation consultancy. We are responsible for the end-to-end product development for some of the biggest brands in the world. We build innovative AI-driven digital experiences used by millions of customers across retail, e-commerce, finance, automotive and other sectors. Operating across five continents with over 6,000 innovators in twenty-two countries, we help organizations reimagine the way they connect with their customers and transform their business operations.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

• The work we do and innovation we drive

• Our Values of share, care and dare

• A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy

• Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The Role:

Valtech Denmark is looking for new enterprise clients. You will be the person that will help win them.

As our Executive Business Developer, you will showcase to Danish enterprise leaders Valtech’s Intelligent Enterprise proposition which connects AI, data, technology, customer experience and operating models to deliver tangible business outcomes.

This is not a conventional sales role. You hunt like a seller, think like a management consultant, use AI and data in your own work and bring the right colleagues in early. You are relentless about results, and you never make the sale about yourself.

You report to the Managing Director, Valtech Nordics, and work day to day with colleagues in strategy, data and AI, experience design, technology and delivery, and with Valtech’s international network of expertise.

Role Responsibilities:

• Own new logo acquisition: identify, engage and win new enterprise clients across Denmark, running every stage from target selection and first contact to pitch, negotiation and close

• Build and execute a GTM plan focused on high-value target accounts and priority industries

• Build relationships with CEOs, COOs, CIOs, CMOs, CDOs and other senior decision-makers

• Open every conversation with a hypothesis about the client’s business, not our service catalogue, and link AI opportunities to the data, processes, technology and organizational capabilities needed to realize value

• Pull strategy, data and AI, design, technology and delivery colleagues in early, and lead pursuits and RFP responses through influence rather than ownership of every idea

• Co-sell with strategic partners (Adobe, Salesforce, Sitecore, Optimizely, Contentful, hyperscalers, etc.), including joint AI-led propositions

• Use AI and data across prospecting, meeting preparation, proposals and forecasting, and keep Salesforce disciplined so the pipeline and forecast can be trusted

• Deliver against your agreed new-business target and represent Valtech at industry events and partner activations

What we expect of you:

• Hunter: You open doors instead of waiting for leads, and can say exactly what you personally contributed to each win.

• Orchestrator: You compete on outcomes, not ego, and share credit with the specialists you involve.

• Consultant mindset: You ask sharp questions, challenge assumptions and frame problems that matter to the business.

• AI and data native: You use AI in your own work, know where it fails and tie it to real business problems, as a commercially credible bridge rather than a technical specialist.

• Energy builder: You bring pace, optimism and a bias for action, backed by a plan and real client conversations, not slogans.

Must have Qualifications:

• Proven track record winning net-new enterprise logos in a digital agency or consulting environment, with a clear view of your personal contribution

• Experience selling complex, multi-million euro engagements across digital experience, data, technology and AI-enabled solutions

• A strong network in Denmark, ideally including senior decision-makers and C-suite relationships

• Exceptional consultative sales skills, with the ability to translate business challenges into impactful digital and AI-enabled strategies

• Practical understanding of how AI and data apply in commercial and customer experience contexts, including where they fall short

• Deep understanding of one or more key industries (e.g., Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences)

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate complex client organizations and mobilize internal specialists

• Strong communication and storytelling skills, with fluency in Danish and English

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

This is a permanent position based in Denmark.

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

• Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs

• Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in @valtech.com.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen, Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professorship (tenure track) in International Politics
jobs.description:
The Department of Political Science and Public Management, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for one or more assistant professorships (tenure) in International Politics. The successful candidate(s) will be affiliated with the Center for War Studies (CWS), one of the department's research centers located at the SDU Odense campus. Starting date is planned for August 1, 2027.

We are looking for talented and dynamic individuals with the ambition of establishing themselves as internationally leading scholars in their field of research. We welcome applicants working across the field of international politics, with particular interest in candidates whose research engages with international security broadly understood. The successful candidate(s) will contribute to strengthening research and teaching in International Politics across the department while becoming active members of CWS. The Center currently hosts internationally leading research on, among other topics, emerging technologies, intelligence studies, and the changing geopolitical landscape.

Application deadline is January 15, 2027, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

CWS is part of the Department of Political Science and Public Management. The Department is organized around six cross-disciplinary research centers and research groups, including CWS. Currently, the department employs around 115 staff and attracts approximately 2,000 students in its various full-time bachelor and master programs as well as part-time professional master programs. For a detailed description of the department's profile and activities and more information about its strategy, please visit the department's website.

jobs.occupation: SMD Operators for a New Evening Shift
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced SMD Operator with a keen eye for quality, stable processes and precision-driven electronics manufacturing? Do you thrive in a technical environment where you take responsibility, work in a structured manner and actively contribute to a strong team? Then you could be our next experienced SMD Operator at NECAS A/S.

About the position

As an SMD Operator at NECAS, you will play a key role in the operation of our SMD lines – the heart of our electronics manufacturing. You will be responsible for setting up, monitoring and optimising processes, ensuring that production meets our high quality standards.

The electronics you help produce are used in everything from industrial and marine applications to defence and aerospace – industries where precision and reliability are essential.

You will become part of a highly skilled team and report to the Team Leader.

Your responsibilities

SMD line operation and preparation

• 
Operate and monitor SMD equipment, including solder paste printer, SPI, pick-and-place, AOI and reflow oven

• 
Prepare the line for production changeovers, including programmes, materials, feeder setup and documentation

• 
Ensure stable operation in accordance with production plans and work instructions

• 
Work with supporting processes such as the washing machine and stencil cleaner

Quality and inspection

• 
Carry out process and quality inspections, including visual inspection and First Article Inspection

• 
Analyse AOI results and respond to deviations

• 
Ensure the correct handling of materials and components, including batch control, traceability and shelf life

• 
Work in accordance with the IPC-A-610 standard (certification provided where required)

• 
Record defects and deviations in the quality management system

Collaboration and continuous improvement

• 
Ensure good communication and effective handovers between shifts

• 
Share knowledge and support colleagues in their daily work

• 
Contribute suggestions for improving processes and workflows

• 
Maintain order and structure in the SMD area in accordance with 5S principles

About you

We are looking for a candidate who already has solid experience in SMD production and is able to work independently in a technically demanding role.

We expect you to:

• 
Have a minimum of 3 years' experience with SMD equipment or electronics manufacturing

• 
Be structured and able to maintain an overview, even during busy periods

• 
Take responsibility and respond quickly when something deviates from the standard

• 
Be a team player who contributes positively to the team

• 
Have a technical understanding and an interest in working with advanced equipment

• 
Language: good command of English, spoken and written

What we offer

At NECAS, you will become part of a growing company where quality and professional expertise are at the heart of what we do. You will receive:

• 
A thorough introduction to our processes and equipment

• 
Opportunities for relevant training and certifications, such as IPC-A-610

• 
A strong team environment and an informal culture with a high level of professional expertise

• 
A workplace in Støvring's newest industrial area, close to the E45 motorway

• 
Competitive terms of employment, including pension and health insurance

About NECAS

NECAS is one of Denmark's leading EMS companies, manufacturing electronics for the industrial, marine/offshore, defence, aerospace and scientific sectors – industries where quality and precision are essential. The company currently has 62 employees.

We are one of the few EMS manufacturers in Denmark with AS9100 certification for the aerospace industry. At NECAS, you will become part of a company experiencing significant growth, where you can develop your professional skills and help push the boundaries of Danish electronics manufacturing.

As we say: Build for trust.

How to apply

The position will be filled as soon as possible. We are inviting candidates to interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send your application and CV as soon as possible. Please apply through our website at www.necas.com/karriere. We read all applications and will contact candidates we would like to get to know better.

If you have any questions, please contact Team Leader Mariana Surleac on +45 92 92 76 20.

BASE life science is a fast-growing consultancy that helps life science companies worldwide deliver better outcomes for their business and their patients. We are looking for a Legal Counsel who wants to join an ambitious and dynamic team and become the in-house legal partner to our business.

About the role

The Legal Counsel is the in-house legal partner to the business at BASE life science. The role owns our contracts, policies and privacy compliance, and uses AI to make legal support faster and easier to use, without compromising on quality.

A substantial part of the role, especially in the first period, is to bring our contract management and our policies fully up to date and compliant - and to keep them that way.

Your responsibilities include:

Contracts

• Own the Master Service Agreement framework, so our agreements are balanced, clear and workable for BASE, our clients and our partners.

• Draft, review and negotiate commercial agreements with sales and delivery leads.

• Take full ownership of contract management: bring every agreement up to date and make the valid version easy to find.

Policies and privacy

• Own our policies, including the data privacy policies and the documentation on personal data, and keep them compliant across the countries where BASE operates.

• Own privacy compliance: manage the external privacy provider and maintain our privacy compliance platform, the Article 30 record and our data processing agreements.

• Run a fixed review cycle with clear owners, so contracts and policies stay current all year.

• Keep BASE audit-ready, support audits and close the findings.

Advice to the business

• Advise on commercial and employment law questions, including country-specific advice in Request for Proposal processes.

• Spot legal risks early, follow changes in laws and regulations, and turn them into clear guidance.

• Support BASE leadership with legal input that fits our strategy and commercial focus.

• Work closely with Infosys Legal, with sparring both ways, and coordinate external law firms and the legal budget.

• Train colleagues in privacy and contract basics, so the business can handle more on its own.

AI in legal work

• Build AI into our legal methods, templates and playbooks, with quality checks so speed never costs accuracy.

• Make relevant legal knowledge available across BASE through our shared AI agents, with the right access and confidentiality controls.

• Contribute the legal perspective to AI governance, including the EU Artificial Intelligence Act.

You bring:

• jur. with 2-3 years of experience from a law firm or an in-house legal team.

• Solid grounding in commercial contracts and in the General Data Protection Regulation in practice.

• Hands-on experience with AI tools in legal work, and a clear view of where human review is required.

• Fluent in Danish and English. Pragmatic, structured and easy to approach.

• An advantage: experience with contract management and privacy compliance systems such as Pactius and ComplyCloud, Request for Proposal processes across countries, and Danish employment law.

What success looks like in the first 12 months

• The Master Service Agreement framework is updated and used consistently.

• Contracts and policies are complete, current and easy to find.

• BASE is audit-ready on privacy, and the privacy provider works to clear priorities.

• AI-supported templates and playbooks are in use, and the business experiences legal support as quicker and easier.

You will be based in Denmark, report to our Chief Operating Officer and work closely with our colleagues in Infosys Legal.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2015, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting company working exclusively in life sciences, built on a simple purpose: grow our people, and deliver real impact for our customers.

We don't think AI is a feature you bolt onto existing systems — we think it's the layer through which a life sciences company's strategy actually gets executed, end to end. Most of the industry is still proving AI can do one task at a time, function by function, pilot by pilot. We're building toward something bigger: AI that runs across clinical, regulatory, quality, and commercial work instead of stopping at the edges of a single application.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Spain, Switzerland, the UK, Germany, France, Italy, and the US, we work with top-10 pharma and ambitious biotechs alike, and with technology partners including Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Google, AWS, Microsoft, and Amass — turning that belief into deployed, compliant, sellable solutions, not slideware.

Why join BASE life science?

You are trusted from day one. Colleagues help each other across teams and countries, speak openly and follow through. We are sharp and professional in what we deliver, and we want the best for each other and for our clients - because the good everyday is something we build together.

You will have real ownership, the backing of our Chief Operating Officer and Infosys Legal, and room to grow. We offer flexibility in how and where you work, a strong focus on well-being and development, and the tools you need to do your best work.

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance

• Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

If you want a role where your legal skills truly matter in a growing international company, we would be happy to hear from you.

If you find this position intriguing, don't delay—submit your application in English at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application.

At BASE life science, we value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Employment decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs

By submitting your application, you consent to the processing of your personal data by BASE life science for the purposes of recruitment and selection. This includes the collection, storage, and use of your personal data as outlined in our Privacy Policy.

Do you want to build the operational backbone behind a new way of monetizing software - where pricing, product usage, data, and billing all need to connect seamlessly?

Trackunit is changing how we charge customers as we move from a traditional SaaS model towards more flexible, usage-based offerings. That means we need to connect a lot of moving parts: what customers use, how that usage is measured, what they have agreed to pay for, and what ultimately appears on their invoice.

As our Senior Monetization Operations Manager, you’ll help us make that entire flow work. You’ll build the processes and checks that help us catch errors early, keep our systems aligned, and give both customers and colleagues confidence that our billing is accurate.

This is a senior individual contributor role with a lot of ownership, but no formal people-management responsibility. You’ll work closely with colleagues across Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, Revenue & Billing and RevOps. Some of the foundations are still being built, so you won’t simply inherit a finished setup. You’ll have an important role in shaping how we work—and we hope that’s the kind of challenge you find energizing.

Trackunit is a fast-growing company and a leading supplier of IoT solutions, operating out of many offices worldwide. We create digital solutions that connect machines, people, and systems in the global construction industry, helping one of the world’s least digitalized industries become more connected, efficient, and productive.

With locations in Denmark, Germany and the Netherlands, we offer a flexible setup giving you the option to work from our hubs or remotely in these countries.

**What’s in it for you?

**

• A place in an agile growth SaaS business, with possibilities to grow internally in the company. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450 employees.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and support them through training, coaching and mindfulness, alongside an open feedback culture that helps you identify your strengths and opportunities. We do this by focusing on your impact on yourself, your team, and the organization.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us. We believe you know how you work best. Once you've decided what works for you, we'll make sure you have the IT equipment and support you need.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. This priority starts with our hiring - we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We assess candidates solely on their qualifications and merit.

**Who are you ideally?

**We’re looking for a hands-on monetization operations expert who combines strong systems and data fluency with the ability to create structure across a complex, cross-functional environment.

**Ideally, You Bring

**

• Experience running or improving usage-based monetization operations, consumption platforms, metering, rating, or another environment where customer usage needs to be captured and processed accurately.

• The ability to follow data through several systems, spot when something doesn’t add up, and work out where the problem started - not just fix the final output.

• Experience setting up and testing products, price plans, usage rules, or similar configurations before they are released.

• A practical approach to processes and controls. You know how to make an operation reliable without creating unnecessary complexity or slowing everyone down.

• The confidence to bring Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, and commercial teams together when an issue crosses several areas - and to keep the work moving until the underlying cause has been resolved.

• Comfort working closely with both technical and commercial colleagues. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be curious about how data and systems work and willing to get into the details.

• The judgment to spot risks, challenge unclear ownership, and set clear standards, even when you don’t formally manage the people involved.

• Experience with usage-metering or monetization platforms such as m3ter, Metronome, Amberflo, or similar would be a strong advantage. Familiarity with Salesforce, NetSuite, Databricks, or related systems would also be valuable, but we don’t expect you to know our exact technology stack from day one.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries - this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this opportunity and your experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification, we'd still love to hear from you.

**Primary Responsibilities

****In this role, you will:

**

• Build and improve the way we run monetization operations, including clear processes, responsibilities, checks, and ways to escalate issues.

• Make sure new products and pricing plans are set up, tested, approved, and released correctly in m3ter and our connected systems.

• Keep track of whether the full flow from customer usage to invoice is working as expected and make risks or gaps visible early.

• Put the right checks in place to identify missing, incorrect, or unusual data before it affects customer billing.

• Work with Finance and Revenue & Billing to make sure the data and documentation needed for invoicing, reconciliation, and audits are ready and reliable.

• Help turn agreed business and pricing rules into system configurations and practical ways of working.

• Lead investigations when usage, system configuration, or billing numbers don’t look right, bringing the relevant teams together to find and fix the underlying cause.

• Work with Product, Engineering, and Data to improve how usage is captured, moved between systems, and monitored.

• Create and maintain useful dashboards, instructions, control records, and documentation so people know what is happening and what to do when something goes wrong.

• Look for recurring problems and manual work that can be simplified or automated as the business grows.

• Help the Monetization Operations Specialist prioritize the right work and provide guidance on more complex issues, while working together as peers in the Monetization team.

**Our hiring process

**Don't waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that's not in the cover letter.

• Initial Interview conversation through zoom with a colleague from our People & Talent team to get to know each other better.

• Virtual meet and greet with the hiring manager and someone from the team.

• Assignment-specific interview. You'll receive a case study to prepare in advance and present to colleagues you'll work closely with in the role.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We're excited to welcome you to Trackunit!

**The question is: Are you in?

**

jobs.occupation: O&M Site Manager - Thor Offshore Windfarm
jobs.description:
RWE is looking for an experienced O&M Site Manager to lead the site-based operations organisation at Thor Offshore Wind Farm. In this key leadership role, you will be responsible for the safe, compliant, reliable and efficient operation and maintenance of the 1 GW wind farm, including its onshore and offshore substations connected to the Energinet transmission system. You will lead a multidisciplinary operations organisation and play a central role in preparing Thor for the transition from the initial OEM service and warranty period to long-term owner-led operations. The role reports to the General Manager for Thor.

**About the role

**

• Lead the day-to-day operations organisation, including three Team Leads, two technician teams and a transmission team responsible for the transmission assets, as well as coordinating external service providers.

• Take overall responsibility for safe, compliant, economical and uninterrupted operations, ensuring adherence to internal requirements, applicable regulations and RWE’s HSE standards and Zero Incident Policy.

• Work closely with the site-based Asset Integrity team and take responsibility for the O&M facilities and logistics setup required to support safe and effective offshore operations.

• Prepare the organisation during the first two years to take over wind turbine service and maintenance activities following the OEM service and warranty period.

• Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement in line with the overall strategy of the RWE Offshore Fleet, setting short-, medium- and long-term operational targets and ensuring their achievement.

• Own the general site and logistics budget, oversee operational performance reporting and contribute to the financial performance reporting of the wind farm.

• Maximise production by ensuring effective maintenance, troubleshooting and monitoring activities, while ensuring that all work is appropriately documented in SAP PM/MM.

• Lead and develop the operations team in line with RWE leadership values, fostering an open, constructive and consistent working environment with a strong focus on safety and operational performance.

**Job requirements and experience

**

• A completed engineering degree or qualification as a state-certified technical engineer.

• At least eight years of relevant experience within offshore wind, power generation or a transmission company.

• Strong knowledge of offshore wind farm organisation and operations, ideally combined with experience in owner operations and HV transmission assets.

• Proven experience in leading and managing teams across multiple organisational levels, combined with strong organisational and planning skills.

• Strong technical and commercial understanding of power plant operations, together with knowledge of offshore-specific areas such as logistics.

• A strong commitment to occupational safety and environmental standards, with experience implementing relevant HSE requirements in an operational environment.

• Extensive knowledge of relevant national and international technical norms and standards, combined with a solution-oriented and decisive approach.

• As this is a site-based role, you are expected to work on site for a minimum of four days per week, with flexibility to travel to site at other times when required.

Given the site-based nature of the role, we expect the successful candidate to be present at the Thor site approximately four days per week, with flexibility to attend on other days when required.

RWE is building Denmark’s largest offshore wind farm. Thor offshore wind farm (TOWF) will be built 22 kilometres off the coast of Thorsminde with a capacity of more than 1 GW. 72 units of Siemens Gamesa’s flagship SG 14-236 DD offshore wind turbines are planned to be installed. Once fully operational in 2027, Thor will produce green electricity to more than 1 million Danish households.

Apply with just a few clicks: ad code 94010, application period: 06/12/2026.

Any questions? Contact HR: Magnus Aarenstrup

We look forward to meeting you. Of course, you can find us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and Xing, too. #LI-MA1

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, disability, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, age, sexual orientation, and identity. #inclusionmatters

Thor will be located approximately 22 kilometres off the coast of Thorsminde on the west coast of Jutland. With a planned capacity of more than 1 GW and 72 Siemens Gamesa SG 14-236 DD offshore wind turbines, it is being developed as Denmark’s largest offshore wind farm to date. Once fully operational in 2027, Thor is expected to generate green electricity equivalent to the annual consumption of more than one million Danish households.

**WHY SPEKTR

**At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

_Compliance, built like product.

_Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

• $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

• Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

• Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**We’re looking for a QA Automation Engineer to help us build and scale high-quality, reliable products as we grow.

You’ll work closely with backend engineers, product managers, and customer-facing teams to build and maintain the automated testing that keeps our platform behaving exactly as intended, especially across complex, AI-driven, API-first systems. If you enjoy writing solid test code, finding the edge cases others miss, and helping teams ship with confidence, you’ll feel at home here.

**What You Will Be Doing

**

• Test Automation: Design, build and maintain scalable automated E2E test suites using Playwright, using LLMs to speed up test generation and maintenance.

• Agent Validation: Build and run test cases and evals that validate AI agent behaviour, so our autonomous compliance workflows are accurate, explainable and hallucination-free.

• API & Data Validation: Test RESTful APIs and validate complex data flows, checking data directly in the database so frontend, backend and AI systems stay fully aligned.

• CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so AI model updates and deployments don’t break existing logic.

• Production Issues: Investigate production issues, reproduce failures and turn them into automated regression tests.

• Quality Practices: Work with engineers and PMs early in development on testability and acceptance criteria, and contribute to our QA processes and standards.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• The Scale-up Mindset: You thrive in fast-moving environments and prefer building systems over following manuals.

• Automation Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frameworks like Playwright.

• API & Database Skills: You’re comfortable navigating backend services, testing RESTful APIs and verifying data integrity with SQL.

• Maintainable Test Code: You don’t just write scripts. You write clean, reusable tests that the rest of the team can build on.

• Communication Skills: You can explain a bug or edge case clearly to both a PM and an engineer.

• Detail Obsession: You have a “sixth sense” for where a system might break and a genuine passion for delivering a polished user experience.

• Curiosity about AI testing: Exposure to testing LLM-based features or eval frameworks is a strong plus.

**OUR TECH INTERESTS

**

• Languages: JavaScript / TypeScript

• Testing: Playwright

• AI/ML: LLM Prompting, LangChain/AutoGPT concepts, Evals frameworks

• Infrastructure: API-driven architectures, SQL databases, CI/CD pipelines

**OUR PROCESS

**

• Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (60 minutes)

**How To Apply

**We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

spektr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic, and we assess every candidate against the same role requirements.

Are you a mechanical, business, industrial or manufacturing engineering student who enjoys understanding how products are designed, manufactured and — most importantly — how they can be made better and more cost-effective?

We are looking for an Intern in Product Cost Excellence to join our team in Horsens.

You will become part of our Cost Excellence function and work closely with a team of three Cost-Out Engineers based in the Czech Republic and Denmark. You will have the opportunity to take ownership of selected cost-out activities, from identifying an opportunity to developing the business case and supporting implementation.

Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include a broad range of product and cost optimization activities, such as:

• Product reviews – analyzing existing cooling product portfolio and identifying opportunities for cost, design and performance improvements

• Cost-out initiatives – identifying and developing opportunities to reduce cooling product cost through redesign, simplification, material changes and product optimization

• Design-to-cost – challenging existing designs and investigating alternative technical solutions

• Dual sourcing – supporting initiatives to qualify alternative suppliers and reduce dependency on single-source components

• Manufacturing optimization – identifying opportunities to improve manufacturing processes, reduce complexity and lower production costs

Our Requirements

We are looking for a curious and analytical student who wants to understand both the engineering and business side of KK Groups Cooling products.

You could be studying:

• Business Engineering

• Manufacturing Engineering

• Mechatronics

• Industrial Engineering

You don't need to be an expert in cost engineering. What matters most is that you:

• Enjoy solving problems and challenging existing solutions

• Are comfortable working with numbers and data

• Have a structured and analytical approach

• Can work independently while knowing when to ask for help

• Are comfortable communicating with people across different functions and countries
